test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the missing word in the sequence.

Meter, Kilometer, Inch, Foot, _____
solution:
All the given words — Meter, Kilometer, Inch, Foot — are **units of length/distance**.

Yard is also a unit of length, so it fits the pattern.

The others don't belong:

 
• **Tesla** → unit of magnetic field
 
• **Gram** → unit of mass
 
• **Coulomb** → unit of electric charge

So the missing word is **Yard**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
